response.sql: WITH patient_level AS (SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB) AS alb, AVG(CAST(l.UN AS REAL) / NULLIF(l."T-BIL", 0)) AS ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(p.SEX) <> '' GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), sex_level AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_level GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) AS mean_alb FROM sex_level) SELECT s.SEX, s.avg_alb AS avg_ALB, s.avg_ratio AS avg_UN_TBIL_ratio, s.avg_alb - o.mean_alb AS alb_above_mean FROM sex_level s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_alb > o.mean_alb

assumptions.assumption: The UN/T-BIL ratio is computed per lab record, then averaged per patient. A zero or NULL T-BIL gives a NULL ratio, which is ignored.
The mean of the sex-level ALB averages is an unweighted average across the sexes present. Sexes whose ALB average is NULL are excluded.
A blank SEX means an empty or whitespace-only string. Those patients are excluded, along with NULL SEX.
